title: fix(plugin-dashboard): compose a chart series label in DashboardGridLayout
body:
Fixes #9172

## What

`DashboardGridLayout` composed `series: [{ dataKey }]` on **both** chart
branches (object-bound and static-data) with **no `label` key at all**. Since
`ChartRenderer` builds its chart config as `newConfig[s.dataKey] = { label:
s.label || s.dataKey, ... }`, the absent label meant the legend/tooltip
rendered the raw field key (e.g. `close_date`) — while `DashboardRenderer`,
the sibling relay composing a chart node for the *same stored widget*,
rendered the humanized one ("Close Date") via its `resolveSeriesLabel`
(objectui#9055).

## Landing point (Zone 2 assumption #2, measured)

The humanizing authority (`humanizeFieldKey`) already lives inside
`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts`, and the missing three-arm decision
(`resolveSeriesLabel`) was a `DashboardRenderer`-local closure in the same
package. Confirmed: the fix belongs entirely inside
`packages/plugin-dashboard/**` — no producer in another package.

## Fix

Moved the three-arm label decision out of `DashboardRenderer`'s local closure
into a shared, plain function — `composeSeriesLabel` in
`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts`:

- arm 1: synthetic y-field (`value`/`count`/none) + an aggregate function →
  i18n'd aggregate name (unchanged behavior, still a live control).
- arm 2: a real object + a real field → `fieldLabel`'s bundle lookup, with
  the **humanized** key as its fallback.
- arm 3: no object name (static-data chart) → the humanized key outright.

`DashboardRenderer` now delegates to it from its own `useCallback` (binding
its own `t`/`fieldLabel`), and `DashboardGridLayout` gained the same
`useCallback` wrapper plus the two missing `label:` compositions. This is the
route Zone 3 suggested ("reuse the existing authority") implemented as a
shared pure function rather than a shared hook instance, so each relay keeps
memoizing against its own `t`/`fieldLabel` — no new cross-component hook
identity to manage (see objectui AGENTS.md #10).

`getComponentSchema`'s `useCallback` dependency array picked up
`resolveSeriesLabel` (was `[]`, now genuinely has one).

## Tests

New pin: `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardGridLayout.seriesLabel-9172.test.tsx`
— the grid relay's own pin (mirroring the sibling's
`fieldKeySpellingOutsideTable-9055.test.tsx`), covering all 3 arms plus a
same-widget **parity** check between the two relays (the actual defect
class objectui#5425 ruled out: "one value, two spellings, one dashboard").
`close_date` / `unit_price` are used because their humanized spelling differs
from the raw key (a control that can actually discriminate fixed vs broken).

**Reverse verification** (defect → fix → restore), all commands run from the
worktree root:

1. Applied the fix, ran the new test file — 6/6 passed.
2. Temporarily replaced `DashboardGridLayout.tsx` with the pre-fix
   (`origin/main` `da45e6b`) content, reran the SAME test file:
   **6/6 failed**, every failure `expected undefined to be '<humanized
   label>'` — the exact defect shape (no label composed at all).
3. Restored via `git checkout HEAD -- packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx`;
   confirmed `git diff HEAD` empty (byte-identical to the committed fix); reran
   — 6/6 passed again.

## Verification

All run from the worktree root (`objectui-issue-9172`), scoped to the
affected package per objectui AGENTS.md's testing discipline:

- Dependency closure build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' build` — clean.
- Package build: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard' build` — clean (`dist/` regenerated).
- Type check: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard' type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) — clean, 0 errors.
- Lint: `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard' lint` — 0 errors (476 pre-existing `any`/fast-refresh warnings, none new to the touched lines beyond the same `any` pattern already used throughout this package's test harnesses).
- Full package test suite: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/` — **118 files / 1121 tests passed** (was 117/1115 before this PR's new file), including both pre-existing pins this card references (`DashboardChart.countSeriesKey-8266.test.tsx`, `fieldKeySpellingOutsideTable-9055.test.tsx`) — no regressions.
- Changeset presence/no-major checks (`scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`) — both pass.

Not run locally (owned by CI per this repo's required-checks set): the full
sharded `pnpm test` (1/4…4/4), `Build & E2E`, `Build Docs`. Nothing in this
diff touches docs, e2e fixtures, or other packages, so no local signal
suggested running them ahead of CI.

## Scope

Diff is exactly the label composition (`DashboardGridLayout.tsx`,
`DashboardRenderer.tsx`'s delegation, the shared `utils.ts` function) plus its
pin and changeset. No findings outside this fence.

## Acceptance notes

None — no incidental findings surfaced while working this fence (existing
`console.warn` dev-hint, `data-testid`, and unrelated `any` usages in the
touched files are pre-existing and untouched).
